prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: back strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1375; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a low-speed collision in a parking lot. Insured vehicle reversed into a stationary claimant vehicle. Police not called; both parties exchanged information at the scene. Photos of both vehicles received from insured. Liability appears probable against insured pending review of the photos and statements.

Entry 2: Claimant has retained counsel. Representation letter received requesting that all further contact be directed to counsel's office. Claimant reports neck and lower back pain following the impact and has been advised to seek medical evaluation. Claim file updated to reflect attorney representation.

Entry 3: Demand package received from claimant's counsel. Documentation includes initial urgent care visit notes diagnosing a lumbar strain, a physical therapy referral, and a request for records covering the prior five years. Records request has been sent to the medical provider. Reserve reviewed and adjusted to reflect the reported injury.

Entry 4: Insured interviewed by phone. Insured confirms reversing from a parking space and did not see the claimant vehicle in the mirror. Insured states the lot was busy and no horn or warning was heard. Statement recorded and filed. Independent appraisal of claimant vehicle scheduled.

Entry 5: Counsel's office contacted to confirm receipt of medical authorizations and to request an estimate of physical therapy visits to date. Liability position remains with insured. Injury evaluation pending receipt of records. File diary set for follow-up in thirty days.
